newsitem.title: USA: Windswept gets $1.5 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Windswept gets $1.5 mln credit facility.

text.p: Windswept Environmental Group Inc said Monday it has received a commitment for a three year, $1.5 million revolving credit facility from North Fork Bank at the bank's prime rate plus 1.5 percent including certain availability and reserve requirements.
The company said the credit line is the first in its history, and will be used to finance current accounts receivable as working capital.
Windswept Environmental is involved in the areas of hazardous waste remediation, asbestos removal, lead clean-up, laboratory testing and emergency spill response.
